昼.meaning: daytime, noon — 昼ご飯 (lunch), 昼間 (daytime)
昼.label: noun

喫.meaning: consume, drink, eat, smoke — 喫茶店 (coffee shop), 喫煙 (smoking)
喫.label: verb

題.meaning: topic, theme, title, problem — 宿題 (homework), 問題 (problem)
題.label: noun

送.meaning: send, escort, see off — 送る (to send), 放送 (broadcast)
送.label: verb

正.reading: セイ, ショウ, ただ(しい), まさ
正.meaning: correct, right, just — 正しい (correct), お正月 (New Year)
正.label: i-adjective

合.reading: ゴウ, ガッ, あ(う), あ(わせる)
合.meaning: fit, join, match, combine — 試合 (match), 合う (to match)
合.label: verb

戦.reading: セン, たたか(う), いくさ
戦.meaning: war, battle, fight — 試合 (しあい, sports match), 戦争 (war)
戦.label: verb

睡.meaning: sleep, doze — 睡眠 (すいみん, sleep)
睡.label: noun

眠.reading: ミン, ねむ(い), ねむ(る)
眠.meaning: sleep, sleepy — 眠い (sleepy), 眠る (to sleep)
眠.label: i-adjective

弁.meaning: speech, dialect, valve, manage — 弁当 (bento), 弁護士 (lawyer)
弁.label: noun

当.reading: トウ, あ(たる), あ(てる)
当.meaning: hit, correct, this, appropriate — 弁当 (bento), 本当 (really)
当.label: verb

末.reading: マツ, バツ, すえ
末.meaning: end, tip, close — 週末 (weekend), 月末 (end of month)
末.label: noun-suffix

携.meaning: portable, carry, take along — 携帯 (mobile phone), 携帯電話
携.label: verb

帯.reading: タイ, お(びる), おび
帯.meaning: belt, zone, sash — 携帯 (mobile/portable), 帯 (kimono sash)
帯.label: noun

丈.meaning: length, height, stature — 大丈夫 (alright, OK), 丈 (length of clothing)
丈.label: noun

夫.reading: フ, フウ, おっと
夫.meaning: husband, man — 夫 (husband), 大丈夫 (alright), 夫婦 (married couple)
夫.label: noun

多.meaning: many, much — 多い (many) — exception trap: i-adjective but cannot precede noun directly (use 多くの instead of 多い人)
多.label: i-adjective

風.meaning: wind, style, manner — 風呂 (bath), 風邪 (cold/flu), 風 (wind)
風.label: noun

呂.meaning: spine, backbone — almost exclusively in お風呂 (おふろ, bath)
呂.label: noun

入.reading: ニュウ, はい(る), い(れる)
入.meaning: enter, put in, insert — 入る (intransitive, to enter), 入れる (transitive, to put in)
入.label: verb

願.meaning: wish, request, pray — お願いします (please), 願う (to wish)
願.label: verb

何.meaning: what — read なん before counters/copula (何ですか, 何時) and なに in most other cases (何を, 何が)
何.label: pronoun

吸います.meaning: to smoke, to inhale, to suck (polite) — dictionary form: 吸う. Most common use: タバコを吸う (smoke a cigarette)
吸います.label: verb-godan

会います.meaning: to meet (polite) — dictionary form: 会う. Particle trap: takes に not を (友達に会う, NOT 友達を会う)
会います.label: verb-godan

撮ります.meaning: to take (a photograph) (polite) — dictionary form: 撮る. Specifically for photos/videos; 取る (also とる) means 'take/grab' generally
撮ります.label: verb-godan
